CREATE TABLE "public"."Appointment" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" text NOT NULL,
  "durationMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "internalNotes" text,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "previousAppointmentId" text,
  "priority" "VisitPriority" DEFAULT 'ROUTINE'::"VisitPriority" NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "reminderPreference" "ReminderPreference" DEFAULT 'NONE'::"ReminderPreference" NOT NULL,
  "room" text,
  "scheduledAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "service" "ServiceType" DEFAULT 'GENERAL_CONSULTATION'::"ServiceType" NOT NULL,
  "source" "BookingSource" DEFAULT 'STAFF'::"BookingSource" NOT NULL,
  "status" "AppointmentStatus" DEFAULT 'PENDING'::"AppointmentStatus" NOT NULL,
  "type" "AppointmentType" DEFAULT 'IN_PERSON'::"AppointmentType" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Appointment_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Doctor" (
  "clinicName" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "licenseNumber" text,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "specialty" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Doctor_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Household" (
  "address" text,
  "contactNumber" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Household_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MedicalRecord" (
  "appointmentId" text,
  "assessment" text,
  "chiefComplaint" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "diastolic" int4,
  "doctorId" text NOT NULL,
  "followUpAppointmentId" text,
  "followUpDate" date,
  "heartRate" int4,
  "heightCm" float8,
  "historyOfPresentIllness" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "oxygenSaturation" int4,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "physicalExamination" text,
  "respiratoryRate" int4,
  "systolic" int4,
  "temperatureC" float8,
  "treatmentPlan" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "visitDate" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "weightKg" float8,
  CONSTRAINT "MedicalRecord_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Patient" (
  "allergyStatus" "ClinicalListStatus" DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN'::"ClinicalListStatus" NOT NULL,
  "bloodType" "BloodType" DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN'::"BloodType" NOT NULL,
  "conditionStatus" "ClinicalListStatus" DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN'::"ClinicalListStatus" NOT NULL,
  "contactNumber" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dateOfBirth" date NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "firstName" text NOT NULL,
  "householdId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text NOT NULL,
  "middleName" text,
  "relationship" "Relationship" DEFAULT 'OTHER'::"Relationship" NOT NULL,
  "sex" "Sex" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Patient_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PatientAllergy" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "reaction" text,
  "severity" "AllergySeverity",
  CONSTRAINT "PatientAllergy_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PatientCondition" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "PatientCondition_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Prescription" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dosage" text NOT NULL,
  "drugName" text NOT NULL,
  "duration" text,
  "frequency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "instructions" text,
  "medicalRecordId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Prescription_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
